study: FP64 canonical GPTQ + numerical reproducibility synthesis
model: Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B (partial-model GPTQ: routed experts of layers 1/8/16/23; everything else BF16)
routing: ORIGINAL R_O forced, asserted equal to natural top-k for every token
act_order: ORIGINAL P_O as explicit override (runs_actorder_ablation/original_actorder.pt); natural argsort of the canonical Hessian recorded and compared, never used

hessian_accumulation.contributions: outer_s = Xf.T @ Xf, FP32 GEMM per (sequence, expert, projection), unchanged
hessian_accumulation.blocks: original positional blocks (i*4)//128 of the ORIGINAL replay order
hessian_accumulation.canonical: per-block FP64 accumulation of the FP32 contributions, blocks summed in FP64 (H64[K,d,d].sum(0)), cast ONCE to FP32; no normalization; damping unchanged (solver-internal)
hessian_accumulation.reconstruction: HN.Fp64Accumulator (the historical control's class) replayed for orders O0/20261121/20261122
hessian_accumulation.gptq_input: stored canonical FP32 Hessian served by LoadedHessianAccumulator inside the unchanged E3 path

order_invariance.require: FP64 sum and FP32 cast bitwise identical across the three orders for all 480 Hessians per strategy; FP32 path == stored preflight Hessians; identical token counts per block; finite and symmetric
order_invariance.claim_scope: tested orders only; not a universal invariance claim

evaluation.metric: PPL = exp(sum NLL / scored targets), EP.layerwise_nll, BF16, natural inference routing
evaluation.repeat: two evaluations per configuration, per-window NLL must be identical

regression.pathway: loaded-accumulator pathway serving ORIGINAL FP32 Hessians must reproduce the frozen OO weights bitwise (FR)

determinism: FR canonical quantized twice in fresh processes: weights, reconstruction, PPL and per-window NLL bitwise equal

estimands.canonical: Delta_FP64 = PPL(FC, S, G0) - PPL(FR, S, G0), one deterministic configuration G0 (no interval)
estimands.order_null: five FP32 accumulation orders (reference distribution of the same pathway; not pooled with other mechanisms)
estimands.execution_marginal: E_{S,G}[PPL(FC,S,G) - PPL(FR,S,G)] over 3 allocation seeds x 5 groupings (existing cross-seed grouping study, ORIGINAL excluded); also the paired mean-NLL version
estimands.window_conditional: paired per-window bootstrap for fixed weights (existing results), conditional on G

canonical.VALIDATED: all mandatory checks pass, canonical Hessians order-invariant under the tested orders, both configurations quantize, FR repeat bitwise reproducible
canonical.NOT_ORDER_INVARIANT: canonical Hessians or weights differ across tested orders / repeats
canonical.BLOCKED: historical artifacts fail validation or a mandatory check fails

execution.MATERIAL: matched execution variants (existing studies) change the sign of FC-FR, or the FC-FR range across matched variants >= 2 x |the reference FC-FR|, while repeated evaluation of identical weights is deterministic
execution.note: decided from the existing studies only; the FP64 result is not used

reporting_rules: exact stored values, no rounded table values
FP64 point is one deterministic reference, not an estimate of the grouping mean
no significance claims from 5 permutations or 3 seeds
